tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: mist, a grey biased to the brand green. Dark: night, the logo's ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the app bar, inputs; sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: empty juz segments, read-only fields, table stripes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders, dividers. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, placeholder text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, memorised juz segments. Deep green in light, bronze in dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Bronze text that must read: eyebrows, tags, the hadith source, in-progress juz label. On surface, surface-raised and bronze-soft.

tokens.name: bronze-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet bronze fill behind bronze-ink: tags, the current juz, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Present (حاضر) and completed states: text and icon on success-soft or surface-raised.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the present badge and success notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Late (متأخر): text and icon on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the late badge and warning notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Absent (غائب), destructive actions, errors: text and icon on danger-soft or surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the absent badge and error notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Excused (مستأذن) and neutral notices: text and icon on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the excused badge and info notices.

tokens.name: progress-current
tokens.usage: The juz being memorised now in JuzProgress: bronze beside green in light, cream beside bronze in dark. At least 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the night Tag: night in light, night-line in dark so it stays visible on night.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the night Tag, on tag-bg.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand ground (ليل المسجد): splash, app icon, covers, print backgrounds. The only ground for the gradient logo.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: A panel on night, e.g. a card on the splash or a social post.

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: The house-lattice pattern and hairlines on night.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: The logo ribbons (نحاس). Brand art, the ribbon device, text on night (8.97:1). Never text on light grounds (1.66:1 on mist).

tokens.name: bronze-shade
tokens.usage: Fold shading inside the logo and the ribbon device. Brand art only, not text.

tokens.name: bronze-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest fold of the logo; the diagonal light on the ribbons. Brand art only.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: The crescent and the two stars (the dots of nun and zay); text on night.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Light brand ground for print and social: letterhead footer, registration post, roll-up base.

families.display: "Reem Kufi", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: One headline per screen or poster. No tashkeel in Reem Kufi.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section openers, certificate titles, social headlines.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app bar, card headlines. Smallest size for Reem Kufi.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, list headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: التسميع: سورة الملك من الآية ١ إلى ١٥

styles.name: body
styles.sample: أتمّ الطالب حفظ الجزء الثلاثين بإتقان.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text. Never below 12px.

styles.name: hadith
styles.sample: مَن غدا إلى المسجدِ أو راحَ، أعدَّ اللهُ له نُزُلَهُ من الجنّةِ
styles.usage: The hadith, Quranic text and other quoted sources, always with full tashkeel and a source line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge; segment gap in the juz bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label to input; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablets; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title; print margins at 1:1.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and poster breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Brand art, tags, the juz segments, the ribbon. The identity is angular.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges: just enough to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards on surface. Prefer the line border; add the shadow only to cards that move or overlay.

size.note: Fixed sizes shared by Flutter, the web and the desktop app.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on phones and tablets (bottom nav, rows, chips).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs on touch screens.

tokens.name: control-height-dense
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs on desktop (mouse and keyboard).

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: Top app bar on every platform.

tokens.name: sidenav-width
tokens.usage: Side navigation on desktop and on the web app (≥ 1024px).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed side navigation (navigation rail) on tablets, 600–1023px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading and form content on wide screens.

breakpoint.note: Window-size classes (Material 3 names) used by every platform.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Phones: bottom navigation, one column, 16px margins.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Tablets and small windows: navigation rail, two columns, 24px margins.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Desktop app and desktop web: side navigation, list + detail panes, 32px margins.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: Wide monitors: content stops at content-max, extra space goes to the margins.

geometry.note: The angles every brand drawing is built from (logo, pattern, icons, ribbon, chamfers).

tokens.name: angle-roof
tokens.usage: The roof and ribbon slope: tan 35° = 0.7. Use for every diagonal.

tokens.name: slope
tokens.usage: Rise per unit run of every diagonal (logo, lattice, ribbon).

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: Corner cut of tags and labels (clip-path), at the roof angle.

tokens.name: stroke-ratio
tokens.usage: Tanween and fine rules are one fifth of the main stroke.
